name: The Councillor's Request
description: Councillor Asha Denn needs biological samples from the deep perimeter for her research into subsurface anomalies.

collect_samples.label: Collect Biological Samples
collect_samples.description: Travel to the perimeter ravine in the deep perimeter east and collect biological samples from the bioluminescent ecosystem.

return_to_asha.label: Return to Councillor Denn
return_to_asha.description: Bring the biological samples back to Councillor Asha Denn at the Civic Center.

completionActions.text: Quest complete: The Councillor's Request. Asha Denn's research could change everything.
